label: Get out
pitch: Leave where you started, and don't come back.
won: You got out. Whether it was worth it is a different question.
lost: You never left. Some people don't.

label: Be rich
pitch: However you have to. Money is the point.
won: You got the money. You can stop counting now.
lost: You never got there. It stayed the thing you were going to do.

label: Be somebody
pitch: You want strangers to know your name.
won: People knew your name. Most of them were kind about it.
lost: You stayed a private person, which you never wanted to be.

label: A house full of people
pitch: You want the loud kitchen and the crowded table.
won: The table was crowded. It was what you wanted and it was hard work.
lost: The house stayed quieter than you meant it to.

label: One person, all the way
pitch: You want to be married to the same person at the end.
judgedBy: You wanted one person, all the way through.
won: The same person, all the way to the end. Almost nobody manages it.
lost: It did not last. Most of them don't.

label: Build something
pitch: You want to leave a thing behind that exists because of you.
won: It outlasted you, which is what building something means.

label: Know things
pitch: You want to understand more than you were handed.
won: You learned more than anyone expected you to.
lost: You stopped studying earlier than you meant to.

label: Get away with it
pitch: You want to take what you want and never be caught.
judgedBy: You wanted to get away with it.
won: You took what you wanted and nobody ever proved a thing.
lost: They caught up with you, the way they usually do.

label: Be good to people
pitch: You want to be the person they call.
judgedBy: You wanted to be good to people.
won: A lot of people would have said you were on their side.
lost: You meant to be that person. It kept not being the year for it.

label: See it all
pitch: You want to be there at the end, however long it takes.
judgedBy: You wanted to see how it all turned out.
won: You saw almost all of it. Very few people do.
lost: It ended before you were finished with it.
